dct_description_sm:
Contains all data and maps for the unit Acadian Deportation and Return, 1750-1803 in the Historical Atlas of Canada Online Learning Project: http://www.historicalatlas.ca/website/hacolp/defining_episodes/social/UNIT_42/index.htm
The unit contains two maps: "Acadian Deportation Experience, 1755-1785" and "Acadian Population Distribution: 1750, 1803"

Data is best viewed in tree view. It is divided into shapefiles, arcmap documents, and supporting documents, including data tables, legends, and snapshots of the maps as displayed on the website.
For documentation explaining the data, see file:
"HACOLP_Acadian_Distribution_Info_20161205.pdf".
This document gives the locations for data pertaining to the different maps within the file structure.
